+        next_header = _CLIXML_HEADER.search(stderr, header.end())

+            output.extend(stderr[cursor:cursor_end])
+            cursor = cursor_end
+            continue

+        # The header may be followed by a line break, but unrelated text is
+        # not part of a CLIXML block.

+            output.extend(stderr[cursor:header.end()])
+            cursor = header.end()
+            continue
+
+        end = stderr.find(b'</Objs>', start)
+        if end == -1 or (next_header and next_header.start() < end):
+            cursor_end = next_header.start() if next_header else len(stderr)
+            output.extend(stderr[cursor:cursor_end])
+            cursor = cursor_end
+            continue

+        end += len(b'</Objs>')
+        # PowerShell can emit several adjacent objects under one header.
+        while more := re.match(rb'\s*<Objs\b', stderr[end:]):
+            following = end + more.end() - len(b'<Objs')
+            close = stderr.find(b'</Objs>', following)
+            if close == -1 or (next_header and next_header.start() < close):
+                break
+            end = close + len(b'</Objs>')
+        block = stderr[header.start():end]

+            replacement = _parse_clixml(decoded.encode('utf-8'))
+        except (ET.ParseError, ValueError, UnicodeError):
+            replacement = None
+
+        output.extend(stderr[cursor:header.start()])
